skill.summary: A collection of PDF manipulation tools from the poppler-utils package. Use when working with PDF files - extracting text, images, metadata, splitting, mergin...

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: 13 PDF tools (pdfinfo, pdftotext, pdffonts, pdfimages, pdfdetach, pdfseparate, pdfunite, pdfsig, pdftohtml, pdftoppm, pdftocairo, pdftops, pdfattach)
